label: Terrain dock all accordions expanded
verdict: CLEAN: No overlapping or clipped elements found — the floating tool panel, terrain sculpting modal, bottom toolbar, scale bar, and status bar are all well-separated; the app is immediately understandable (hint text "Pick a mode, then click + drag", Getting Started guide, and status bar showing active tool "Raise" all reinforce each other). Only trivial nits: the left sidebar's last item ("Patio") is cut at the sidebar's scroll boundary, and "Measure" sits under the "VIEW" group where a "Tools" group might read more naturally — neither blocks comprehension.
